changes.summary: Focus translated installation guides on first setup, keeping links to advanced procedures
Record the owner-reported No-root installation on LG 43UQ75003LF
Allow System Updater self-update, verified repair and signed delivery for Root and No-root on rooted TVs
Repair the retained Root Beta recovery service in place when verified; B9 device confirmation pending
Reconcile a retained Root filter after a specific verified refusal; C1 device confirmation pending
Finish verified No-root removal with only protected empty Helper directories left; EF950V startup remains unresolved
Give the screensaver companion its own landscape icon
Explain and restart a stopped Home Helper from No-root Home and Screensaver settings
Restore No-root Helper controls, authenticate historical Root System replacement and sign a private System QA catalog
Admit legacy No-root captures, release Helper locks reliably and preserve the verified standalone screensaver on update and rollback
Preserve the default Developer Mode renewal preference and its ownership during No-root System updates

acceptance: LG OLED55C3RLA, firmware 43.21.71, macOS ARM64. Exact private production-signed Root and rooted No-root System 1.2.10 to 1.2.11 updates migrated the engine and own IPK and completed the edition update. Profiles, Developer Mode renewal state on No-root, Screensaver, network Home, same-version repair, ordinary product rollback and verified software restart passed. Exact Helper evidence carries from 44052108345:1. Engine SHA-256 637dc606d8c4fdeb1f5560b6dbe3f7e35c9a738254637b74b95bdaf2a6f83b98. Earlier published System 1.2.10 uses desktop replacement. B9, reported C1 and EF950V retain offline evidence, and genuinely unrooted System self-update remains outside this acceptance. See docs/history/2026-11-17-release-1.23.0-rc-verification.md.
